evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml (step1.patch:55-100) runs on pull_request and push to main, `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in site/, which are real scripts in site/package.json:13-16. Top-level `permissions: contents: read`; pr-title.yml uses `permissions: {}` and passes the title through env, not interpolation (step1.patch:187-205). pages.yml has build with contents:read and deploy with only pages:write/id-token:write (step1.patch:118-165), and PAGES_BASE matches site/vite.config.ts:11. release.yml grants contents:write only to its job and uses only github.token. Every action is pinned to a 40-char SHA with a version comment. There is no pull_request_target, and nothing was run or pushed. Minor gap: pages.yml also has `workflow_dispatch` with no ref guard (step1.patch:116), so deploying only from main depends on the github-pages environment's branch rule. RELEASING.md:638-639 documents that rule, but the workflow does not enforce it.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch:425-553) covers requirements (.nvmrc Node 22), install (`npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`, `index`, `fieldsets`, `prepare-data`), test (`npm test`, `npm test -- src/lib/data.test.ts`, and that file exists), build/preview, the PAGES_BASE build (read in vite.config.ts:11), CI, contributing data with sources and the record-count tests, the commit convention, releases, and the MIT license (LICENSE:1). Every command shown exists in site/package.json. The paths it mentions (site/.gitignore for generated files, data/bullets/README.md, THIRD-PARTY.md) also exist.
evidence.s1_release: RELEASING.md states that the version lives in site/package.json and package-lock.json, that SemVer applies with a pre-1.0 rule, and gives the steps: `npm version --no-git-tag-version`, rename Unreleased, a `chore(release)` PR, then tag `v<version>`. release.yml plus scripts/release-notes.mjs check that tag, package.json, lock and a dated changelog heading agree, and publish the section as notes. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0. Dependabot covers npm and actions. The convention (Conventional Commits plus a `data` type) is in CONTRIBUTING.md and the README. All 7 commits in commits.txt follow it. Small inconsistencies: CONTRIBUTING assigns dependencies to `build`, but dependabot.yml uses `prefix: chore` for npm (step1.patch:16-18). The Dependabot config commit is `build(deps)` (commits.txt:5), while the table assigns `.github/` automation to `ci`.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed with per-key decoding (router.ts, step2.patch:512-523), with href.compare and an App.svelte branch, so it works on reload. One SVG has role=img, aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}`, and one `<path>` per case (Compare.svelte step2.patch:658-667). The table has caption `Dimensions (mm|in)`, headers Symbol / name A / name B / Difference, symbols from FIELD_LABELS, and Difference = B-A. Only cartridge-part numbers without a FIELD_UNITS entry are used, with no *Tol fields (compare.ts dimensionsOf). Units follow unitSystem(): formatValue for metric, displayNumber(...,'in') for imperial. The detail page has a Label `Compare with`, a NativeSelect of the other cartridges by name, and a submit Button `Compare` going to href.compare(key, chosen) (Cartridge.svelte step2.patch:575-583). German strings are provided, and shot cartridges get no profile. A changelog entry, tests and a feat commit are present. No requirement is unmet.
evidence.s2_correctness: The overlay uses viewportFor([pa,pb], {scale:1, frame:'landscape'}), so both share one scale and one axis, and z=0 maps to the same x for both head faces. Each outline is fullSectionPath, which is closed and mirrored (compare.ts overlay). The test checks head x, L3 lengths, axis symmetry and the 12.01 rim (compare.test.ts step2.patch:192-212). `difference` computes B-A in scaled decimal, so 12.01-11.96 gives 0.05 rather than float noise, and it falls back for exponent notation. Metric values use formatValue (String(value), no rounding). Imperial values use displayNumber, and the difference is converted the same way. ScaleRuler gets widthMm for metric and unitsPerUnit=25.4 for inches, which is consistent with a 1 mm viewBox unit (ScaleRuler.svelte:25). Shotshell and too-thin records give a null profile and a note. Unknown keys reach the {:catch} branch through load()'s rejection. Malformed routes fall back to the list.
evidence.s2_fit: It reuses lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue, PX_PER_MM), lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile) and site components (PageHeader, ScaleRuler placed right after the svg per UI.md:37, shadcn Label/NativeSelect/Button as in GlobalSettings.svelte:14-15). Styles are in `@layer legacy` scoped by `data-ui` as UI.md:20 asks, and the numeric styling mirrors GroupTable.svelte:231-245. The changes are limited to the route, router, nav, metadata, i18n and the detail page. Minor issues: compare.ts:290-292 re-implements the group ordering of site/src/lib/fields.ts:23-26 (orderedGroups) instead of calling it, and the print-CSS selector added in Cartridge.svelte (step2.patch:607) is mis-indented.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts follows the vitest setup (src/**/*.test.ts) and reads the real 308_win and 300_win_mag records. It tests dimension selection: order, exclusion of FIELD_UNITS fields, Tol fields and chamber fields, label rendering, and skipping odd values. It tests decimal differences, metric and imperial row text against formatValue/displayNumber, and that the profile equals caseOuterProfile's output. Geometry assertions cover the overlay (one scale, common head x, axis, closed paths), and the English and German strings are checked. router.test.ts adds parse/href round-trips and malformed fallbacks. Not covered: the Compare.svelte markup (role/aria-label/caption/headers) and the detail page's Compare-with control. The repo has no component-test setup, so this is a modest gap.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: compareRows now builds the union of both records' symbols and leaves the missing side and Difference as '' (step3.patch:108-141). New tests assert that `delta L` (A only) and `R3` (B only) appear with empty cells, and check ordering (step3.patch:23-53). Style: Compare.svelte already right-aligns th and td except the Symbol column since step 2 (step2.patch:754-757, `@layer legacy`, with no competing text-align rule in app.css/layout.css). The final state meets point 2, but step 3 made no change for it and left no record of verifying it. Related text was updated to match (the lede and noShared strings in en/de, which is a justified consequence). The merge ordering gives an odd result when a B-only symbol precedes every shared one: the test enshrines L2 before L1 (step3.patch:65-68). The edited changelog entry has an awkward line break (step3.patch:10-12).
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 adds an Added bullet under `## [Unreleased]` (step2.patch:9-11). Step 3 updates that unreleased entry to describe the fixed behaviour (step3.patch:9-12), which is correct for an unreleased feature under Keep a Changelog. The version stays 0.1.0, consistent with RELEASING.md, where the version is bumped only in a release PR. Commits `feat(site): compare two cartridges` and `fix(site): list every dimension in the cartridge comparison` follow the convention and would pass the pr-title regex. The code is typed against Record_/Group and the target is ES2022 (Object.hasOwn is fine). A built site/dist containing Compare chunks exists in the snapshot, so the CI test/build is likely to pass.

strengths: A complete, secure step 1 setup: SHA-pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, a PR-title check with an injection-safe env, and a tag-triggered release guarded by a script that cross-checks the tag, package.json, the lock file and the changelog. The README's commands all exist.

The compare view meets every step 2 requirement by reusing lib/shapes2d, lib/geom, lib/core and the site's components (PageHeader, ScaleRuler, shadcn controls). It computes B-A differences in decimal, avoiding floating-point noise.

The tests are meaningful, use the real records and the repo's vitest setup, and check the overlay's geometry (common head face, scale, axis), the dimension selection rules, the unit formatting and the German strings.
issues: Step 3 made no change for the alignment point and left no note that step 2's CSS already right-aligns the numeric columns and headers. The merge order for B-only symbols can also put them ahead of A's first row (the test locks in L2 before L1).

pages.yml also triggers on `workflow_dispatch` with no branch guard. Deploying only from main then relies on the github-pages environment's branch rule, a repository setting, rather than on the workflow.

Small inconsistencies in conventions and code: Dependabot npm commits use `chore(deps)` though CONTRIBUTING assigns dependencies to `build`; the Dependabot config commit is typed `build` rather than `ci`. compare.ts re-implements orderedGroups' group ordering instead of reusing it.
review.verdict: All three steps are solid, convention-following work: secure workflows, an accurate README, a consistent release process, and a compare view that meets every stated requirement with good reuse and tests. The remaining issues are minor: alignment was not addressed explicitly in step 3, a slightly odd row order for one-sided symbols, an unguarded workflow_dispatch on Pages, and small inconsistencies in commit types.
